Harness sensors read the GitHub Actions run history of the population their declaration in .devai/config/sensor-inputs.json names (ADR-SCR-0005 IA-004, ADR-SCR-0010); the broker admits exactly this shape without a host adapter under sense run and check: <file> is one workflow file name of letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen ending in .yml or .yaml, without a directory; <event> is one of push, pull_request, merge_group, workflow_dispatch, or schedule, nothing else; <fields> is one to sixteen comma-separated alphabetic names; the limit is the literal 1000, so a thirty-day window at the current volume of about 450 runs is never cut, and a list that returns 1000 runs reads unknown as truncated (#364). This shape carries no --branch option and is emitted when the declared headBranch is * (any head branch); gh-run-list-branch adds the single --branch <ref> option for a literal head branch, and the -created variants add the --created filter. Each option appears once and in this order; a second --branch, a value outside its grammar, and every other gh argv except auth, auth status, --version, and --help are refused.

ADR-SCR-0015 and ADR-SCR-0017: only sense run's internally trusted member/task binding admits this process. The executable marker is descriptive, never a runnable command or generic argv shape. Admission binds the exact sensorKinds annotation, population, candidate commit/tree, descriptor and task-policy digests, executable path and byte digest, complete argv, contained cwd, input selectors, dependency completion and toolchain/allowlisted environment identities. A caller cannot manufacture the internal binding; wrong kind, added arguments, changed policy, absent prerequisite custody and unmatched executable bytes refuse before execution. Every bound task requires explicit --write and fs:workspace; fs:f5-state permits only the exact verified task-process target's content-addressed .devai/state/check-cache/v1 write and grants no other state path, native provenance trace or proof write. migration_check additionally retains db:write. Read presets refuse these members and no remote effect is inferred.

ADR-SCR-0017: descriptive annotation only for the internally trusted native resultPopulation binding and package-owned reporter/provenance path; no generic argv or caller flag is admitted. Existing exact task process identity and explicit --write remain mandatory. Native-only fs:proofs covers the verified origin append to record/proofs/chain.json, creation of record/proofs if absent, and exclusive exact chain.json.tmp.<pid>.<time> staging renamed only to that chain. An internal origin-operation guard must refuse all other proof paths, deletes and unbound writes. Native-only fs:f5-state covers .devai/state/native-config-traces/<internally-minted-nonce> and its exact transient trace artifacts/owned cleanup; parent directory creation grants no sibling write. The same exact native state operation may create only the fresh empty nonce/runtime directory, internally bind TMPDIR and PWTEST_CACHE_DIR beneath it with caller overrides refused, and admit finite verified framework generated-cache artifacts through an ordered successful mkdir/full-write/rename/remove custody ledger and owned cleanup. The main-process pre-import checkpoint proves the physical runtime root empty; cache reads require a matching live same-execution generated identity. Opt-in Playwright 1.60.0 resultPopulation internally binds --output to the exact nonce/runtime/playwright-results root, overriding config outputDir and refusing caller output flags. Preserve authored task argv/portable identity while privately binding the actual Node identity, complete effective argv and output root; every selected reporter-resolved project outputDir must agree. Its separate fresh/no-link result ledger admits only this root, immediate .playwright-artifacts-<decimal-integer> or ASCII [A-Za-z0-9_-]+ directories, owned directory metadata/creation/cleanup and ordered full-write/removal of root .last-run.json. Arbitrary files, deeper artifacts, unowned overwrites and every rename involving results, including cache/result cross-renames, refuse. Result artifacts grant no readFile, executable, module-load or transformed-source input credit; transformed-source credit remains confined to verified transform-cache .js identities. No arbitrary state-output or browser/attachment effect is admitted. This grants no ambient temporary-directory or external-file permission. Native worker and asynchronous loader control channels are private to their minted scopes; original workerData, loader initialization data and transfer semantics are preserved before candidate imports. Each scope must persist its own end and acknowledge only after supported I/O is complete; the parent wait is bounded to five seconds, and missing acknowledgement or post-seal activity refuses standing. Parent exit or termination cannot invent an end. The host verifies closure and captures complete supported native provenance observations. Ordinary task-bound and read observations gain neither capability nor receipt/trace authority. No public action, role or general workspace/proofs permission is added.

The build sensor compiles the workspace (ADR-AUT-0002); the compiler writes under the package directories, so the process is a write and never read-only, and recording its reading is an inspector harness-write under the self-dogfood matrix. Under sense run the broker admits exactly this shape without a host adapter. The sensor takes its argv and cwd from the sources argv_precedence lists in that order: a test-tasks.json build node wins, and a build entry in .devai/config/sensor-inputs.json is admitted only when the descriptor has no build node; a declaration whose argv differs from the descriptor node is a declaration defect that the declared-inputs contract test rejects naming both argv and that the sensor reads as error with conflict_code. A declared argv outside this shape is refused before a process starts.

argv_precedence.rule: The argv and cwd of the node whose nodeId is build; when the node exists it is the build sensor's command and no declaration may replace it.
The build input's argv and optional cwd; admitted only when test-tasks.json has no build node, which is the adopter case without a descriptor.
